payload.summary: callModel sends OpenRouter Chat Completions with response_format json_schema (strict) built from a valibot schema, then validates the reply with valibot again
rationale: Every model call our server makes (memory extraction, evals) goes through OpenRouter (@openrouter/sdk); the live voice agent instead uses an ElevenLabs built-in model
Structured outputs accept anyOf but not oneOf, which valibot variant emits; toJsonSchema overrideSchema renames oneOf to anyOf node by node
Strict structured outputs reject array size limits, so valibot schemas sent to callModel avoid maxLength on arrays and cap in code
The $schema draft marker is dropped because the API has no use for it
consequences: Any finish reason other than stop, non-JSON output, or a valibot failure returns ok: false
The default model is the BACKGROUND_MODEL constant in src/config.ts (an OpenRouter slug); callers may pass model per request
